verdict.rationale: The axis applies: the card ships a UI (AMD Software with one-click HYPR-RX profiles, Anti-Lag, FSR and other settings), so a buyer can fairly ask whether those controls are also exposed programmatically. Nothing in the evidence documents an API or CLI covering those UI controls. ROCm and the HIP libraries are compute-programming APIs, an adjacent capability that does not show UI-to-API parity.
